name: Dependency scanning (SCA) MUST be implemented in build pipelines to detect known vulnerabilities in third-party libraries, and critical vulnerabilities MUST break the build to prevent deployment of compromised code.
requirementTitle: Dependency scanning (SCA) MUST be implemented in build pipelines to detect known vulnerabilities in third-party libraries, and critical vulnerabilities MUST break the build to prevent deployment of compromised code.
requirementDescription: Your CI/CD pipeline must automatically scan all third-party packages and libraries for known security vulnerabilities. If a critical vulnerability is found, the deployment must be stopped until it is fixed or formally approved as an exception.
why:
Modern attacks often exploit weaknesses in third-party libraries rather than vulnerabilities in code written by our developers.
Most applications rely on hundreds or thousands of open-source packages. If one of those packages contains a known critical vulnerability, an attacker may be able to compromise an entire application.
